name: Gulf of Porto: Calanche of Piana, Gulf of Girolata, Scandola Reserve
description: On Corsica's wild west coast, this stretch of shoreline is dominated by the Scandola peninsula, a mass of red volcanic rock that drops straight into the Mediterranean. Boat trips weave past islets, sea caves and the cliffs of Piana, while sea eagles, gulls and cormorants wheel overhead. Dense scrubland covers the slopes, and the clear water below teems with marine life.
